testcase.name: Scenario: Clear an incompatible search and type filter: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-home-recent-documents-source/features/application/home-recent-documents/home-recent-documents.feature:215:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Clear an incompatible search and type filter ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the recent list includes a part named "Part26" and other document types ✔ And no assembly matches "Part26" ✔ And no recent-document filters are active ✔ When the user searches recent documents for "Part26" ✔ Then the matching part is displayed ✔ When the user opens Filter and selects Assembly ✔ Then the filter control indicates one active filter ✔ And No results is displayed ✔ And the search field still contains "Part26" ✔ When the user activates Clear search and filters ✔ Then the search field is empty ✔ And the broader recent list includes parts and assemblies ✔ When the user opens Filter ✔ Then Assembly is unchecked ✔ And All is selected under Date Modified
